Context: Conditions for grant of benefits :

17. (i) For grant of financial upgradation under the MACP Scheme, the prescribed Benchmark shall be 'Very Good', for all levels. This shall be effective for upgradations under MACPS falling due on or after 25-7-2016 and the revised benchmark shall be applicable for the APARs for the year 2016-17 and subsequent years.
